# TB. Manon Jaya Putra

TB. Manon Jaya Putra is a building material store in Cisaat, Sukabumi, Jawa Barat, Indonesia.

## Primary Page

- Homepage: https://manonjaya.com/

## Business Summary

TB. Manon Jaya Putra provides building materials for home renovation, house construction, daily repair needs, and local project preparation in Sukabumi.

## Products And Categories

- Struktur dan rangka: besi beton, wiremesh, baja ringan, kayu, triplek
- Finishing rumah: cat, plafon, pintu, engsel, kunci
- Instalasi dan perlengkapan: pipa, kabel, saklar, stop kontak, lem, sealant, alat kerja
